description: 1. ParentChild Pivot is a custom Power BI visual that rebuilds parent-child hierarchies and provides tree/flat navigation, node search, dynamic columns, and multi-measure pivot analysis. 2. It is designed for BI analysts, finance controllers, operations managers, and data teams working with multi-level structures such as P&L statements, org charts, cost centers, and bill-of-materials. 3. It solves the pain of exploring complex hierarchies with standard visuals, reduces analysis time, and improves decision speed through cross-visual filtering, node expand/collapse, and consistent aggregated views.
